description: Push changes into the app's Git repository as ONE atomic commit (create, patch, and delete in a single push). CHANGING an existing file? Use `edits` — an exact-snippet replacement, like your editor's edit tool. Use `files` only to create a NEW file or to genuinely rewrite one end to end: it resends the whole document, so a twelve-line change costs you the entire file. Both may appear in the same push (different paths). If the app has no repository yet, a platform-managed repo is created automatically on the first push. Text files only (UTF-8) — for binary assets (icons, images, fonts) NEVER attempt to inline the bytes; models cannot generate valid binary data. Instead use runzero_upload_assets (the user uploads via the dashboard) or set sourceUrl on a file entry (the server downloads it from the web). IMPORTANT: after the FIRST push on a fresh app, run runzero_deploy once — it creates the service(s) from the repo (single service from the root, or several from a run-zero.yaml). Later pushes rebuild existing services automatically. See runzero_get_help topic 'files' for the full flow, code layout rules and the run-zero.yaml format. Only works with platform-managed repositories, not external repos. `deletions` and `files` overwrite or remove files in the repo; earlier content stays in the Git history.

deletions.description: File paths to delete from the repo

edits.description: Patches to existing files — the cheap way to change code. Applied in order; several edits may target the same file and are applied one after another.

newString.description: Replacement text. An empty string deletes the matched snippet.

oldString.description: Exact text to replace, copied verbatim from the file including indentation and line breaks. Must match exactly once unless replaceAll is set — include a surrounding line or two to make it unique.

path.description: Path of an EXISTING file in the repo

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match (default: false)

files.description: Files to create or rewrite completely. To change part of an existing file use edits instead.

content.description: UTF-8 text content (exactly one of content/sourceUrl per file)

path.description: File path within the repo (e.g. index.html, assets/logo.png)

sourceUrl.description: https URL the platform downloads server-side and commits as this file — use for images/fonts that already exist on the web

trigger_build.description: Trigger a build after pushing (default: true)

name: runzero_push_files
title: Push files
